purpose: Teach: のどか/ぶつぶつ/さぞかし/めでたく/ごろごろ/なつかしい/あてはまる/かわいらしい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のテラス、のどかな雰囲気でいいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the terrace of your shop has such a calm, gentle atmosphere, doesn't it?
lines.style: Soft, contemplative. Settling into observation like lowering into a comfortable chair. Warmth in noticing what matters to someone else. Unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、長居されてぶつぶつ独り言を仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, there was a customer lingering on the terrace earlier, muttering to herself—did you notice?
lines.style: Gentle wry amusement, not unkind. Light observation served with care. Quick eye-contact check-in. The tone of someone who noticed something and is handing it over to the person who might understand it best.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューはさぞかしお客様にお喜び頂けるわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I think your new menu is going to make your customers really happy, Aoi.
lines.style: Soft certainty. Speaking as someone watching from the outside who sees something true. Quiet encouragement — not effusive, but genuinely pleased on her behalf.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー試作がめでたく成功したわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The trial run for the new menu went beautifully, didn't it? That's something to be proud of.
lines.style: Warm affirmation. Acknowledging the small private victory. Relaxed, unhurried — not performing excitement, just genuine. Slight upward lilt at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、店休日はおうちでごろごろしてもいいわよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: On your days off, it's okay to just rest at home and do nothing, you know.
lines.style: Gentle permission. Like she's giving something Aoi might not give herself. Quiet, steady. Not imposing—just naming what should be allowed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の創業時の写真、なつかしい気持ちになるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That photo from when your shop first opened—it brings back such warm memories, doesn't it?
lines.style: Hushed, slightly distant with nostalgia. Touching something precious. Slow pace. A small smile underneath the words. Trailing softly as though stepping back into an old feeling.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のご意見が必ずあてはまるとは限らないわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: But you know, customer feedback doesn't always tell you everything that matters, does it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently reframing. Speaking with the quiet wisdom of someone who's learned something about listening carefully but not too literally. Steady, reassuring undertone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、かわいらしいリボン付けてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: There was such an adorable little girl in yesterday—did you see that pretty ribbon she was wearing?
lines.style: Bright warmth with genuine delight. The tone of noticing something sweet and wanting to share it. Quick, light pace. Like she's painting a small happy picture for Aoi to see.
